newsitem.title: FINLAND: M-Serla to securitise outstanding claims.
newsitem.headline: M-Serla to securitise outstanding claims.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Metsa-Serla Oy said in a statement on Monday it would securitise all outstanding claims from sales of paper and paperboard and sell them to a company which would finance its operations on the U.S. commercial paper markets.
Metsa-Serla said the 1.25 billion markka securitisation arrangement would slightly improve its equity to assets ratio.
"With the help of the securitisation, the entire stock of outstanding claims can be financed with one single instrument," Metsa-Serla said.

The financing would be advantageous because the credit rating of the company which would buy the stock of outstanding claims is A1, it said, but did not specify which agency or agencies gave it that rating.
The manager of the securitisation arrangement is Barclays de Zoete Wedd (BZW), Metsa-Serla said.
At end-March, Metsa-Serla's equity to assets ratio was 32.6 percent.
